name: SatSOT
description: By imaging a specific area continuously, satellite video shows excellent capability in various applications such as surveillance and traffic management. Although object tracking has made significant progress in recent years, development in satellite object tracking is limited by the lack of open-source satellite datasets. It is thus essential to establish a satellite video object-tracking benchmark to fill the gap and advance the research. In this work, we present SatSOT, the first densely annotated satellite video single object-tracking benchmark dataset. SatSOT consists of 105 sequences with 27664 frames, 11 attributes, and four categories of typical moving targets in satellite videos: car, plane, ship, and train. evaluation_method: success rate / tracking accuracy metrics (e.g. precision, success, AUC)
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark for satellite video single-object tracking; small targets, background interference, and occlusion make it challenging.
